caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil illustration of a stylized bird, depicted in profile view facing left. The bird has a prominent head with an open beak, a distinguishable eye, and a comb or wattle under its chin. The neck and upper body are covered in short, dense feather markings. One wing is visible and is shaded darker than the rest of the body, while the tail fans out in a wide, rounded shape with layered, curved feather segments that are heavily textured with parallel lines and shaded gradations. Below the bird, there is a horizontal scale marked with units, suggesting a measurement reference. The drawing is contained within a rectangular border, and the paper is aged with minor yellowing and a few scattered spots or marks. The artist's signature, "Bernard Westmacott," is located in the bottom left corner outside the border.
title: Weather Vane
